frequency_question: How often do executive principals with stated intent to renew a major water sharing treaty successfully sign the instrument within the target window?
membership_rule: Includes formal intergovernmental bilateral water-sharing treaties or major amendments/successors expiring and successfully re-signed or extended by mutual executive agreement. Excludes purely unilateral declarations or failed negotiations where no treaty text was finalized.

validity_reason: Bilateral diplomatic norms and executive-level water negotiation frameworks in South Asia have remained structurally consistent over recent decades.
